setups.name: RSI Bullish Divergence (Lower Low, RSI Higher Low)
setups.description: Price makes a lower low while RSI makes a higher low; typically occurs in oversold territory (<30).
setups.entry_condition: Price breaks above swing high after RSI forms HHL pattern
setups.invalidation: Price closes below the lower low (sweep point)
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: previous swing high; 2nd: structural resistance above
setups.sl_placement: Below the lower low candle body
setups.risk_factor: False divergence if trend resumes; validate with price action

setups.name: RSI Bearish Divergence (Higher High, RSI Lower High)
setups.description: Price makes a higher high while RSI makes a lower high; typically in overbought territory (>70).
setups.entry_condition: Price breaks below swing low after RSI forms LLH pattern
setups.invalidation: Price closes above the higher high
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: previous swing low; 2nd: structural support below
setups.sl_placement: Above the higher high candle body
setups.risk_factor: Trending markets often violate divergence; use HTF bias check

setups.name: MACD Hidden Bullish Divergence (Higher Lows, Histogram Continues Up)
setups.description: Price makes higher lows while MACD makes higher lows; histogram bars remain positive; signals continuation within uptrend.
setups.entry_condition: MACD bars cross above zero or previous bar high after price HHL
setups.invalidation: MACD histogram flips negative or price closes below HHL low
setups.tp_logic: Target higher swing high in continuation; trail SL above recent swing
setups.sl_placement: Below the higher low in price (HHL confluence)
setups.risk_factor: Less powerful than regular divergence; requires strong HTF confirmation

setups.name: MACD Hidden Bearish Divergence (Lower Highs, Histogram Continues Down)
setups.description: Price makes lower highs while MACD makes lower highs; histogram bars remain negative; signals continuation within downtrend.
setups.entry_condition: MACD bars cross below zero or previous bar low after price LLH
setups.invalidation: MACD histogram flips positive or price closes above LLH high
setups.tp_logic: Target lower swing low in continuation; trail SL below recent swing
setups.sl_placement: Above the lower high in price (LLH confluence)
setups.risk_factor: Requires strong HTF confirmation; weak signal if HTF is ranging

setups.name: Stochastic Bullish Divergence (%K Higher Low, Price Lower Low)
setups.description: %K line makes higher low while price makes lower low; typically in oversold zone (< 20).
setups.entry_condition: Price breaks above the divergence high candle + %K crosses above %D
setups.invalidation: Price closes below the lower low
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: swing high above entry; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the lower low candle body
setups.risk_factor: Stochastic can stay overbought in strong trends; validate with RSI

setups.name: Stochastic Bearish Divergence (%K Lower High, Price Higher High)
setups.description: %K line makes lower high while price makes higher high; typically in overbought zone (> 80).
setups.entry_condition: Price breaks below the divergence low candle + %K crosses below %D
setups.invalidation: Price closes above the higher high
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: swing low below entry; 2nd: structural support
setups.sl_placement: Above the higher high candle body
setups.risk_factor: Stochastic can stay oversold in strong downtrends; confirm with RSI

setups.name: Volume Divergence (Price Up, Volume Down = Weakness)
setups.description: Price makes higher high but volume on the up-move is lower than previous rallies; signals weakening bullish momentum.
setups.entry_condition: Short on volume divergence + price fails to break above resistance
setups.invalidation: Volume spikes above average on push higher
setups.tp_logic: Target the previous swing low or key support
setups.sl_placement: Above the higher high with declining volume
setups.risk_factor: Volume can be misleading in low-liquidity periods; requires multi-bar confirmation

setups.name: Cumulative Volume (OBV) Divergence (Price Up, OBV Down)
setups.description: Price makes higher high but OBV makes lower high; indicates selling pressure despite price advance.
setups.entry_condition: Short entry on OBV divergence failure + OBV breaks below its MA
setups.invalidation: OBV crosses above its previous high
setups.tp_logic: Target support levels below entry; scale out at -R increments
setups.sl_placement: Above the higher high in price
setups.risk_factor: OBV lags; combine with real-time volume confirmation

setups.name: Momentum Divergence (Price Up, Momentum Down)
setups.description: Price makes HH but Momentum oscillator makes LH; signals slowing upside acceleration.
setups.entry_condition: Short on momentum LH + price fails to break resistance candle
setups.invalidation: Momentum spikes above its recent high
setups.tp_logic: Target: swing low below entry; partial profits at -R level
setups.sl_placement: Above the price high
setups.risk_factor: Momentum can stay positive in extended trends; validate with price action

setups.name: CCI Divergence (Price Higher High, CCI Lower High)
setups.description: Price makes HH while CCI makes LH; suggests weakening momentum into resistance.
setups.entry_condition: Short after CCI divergence + CCI crosses below +100 level
setups.invalidation: CCI spikes above +100 or price closes above entry high
setups.tp_logic: Target: recent swing low or demand zone below
setups.sl_placement: Above the price high by 10-15 pips
setups.risk_factor: CCI is laggy in ranging markets; confirm with price action

setups.name: CCI Divergence (Price Lower Low, CCI Higher Low)
setups.description: Price makes LL while CCI makes HL; suggests weakening momentum into support.
setups.entry_condition: Long after CCI divergence + CCI crosses above -100 level
setups.invalidation: CCI spikes below -100 or price closes below entry low
setups.tp_logic: Target: recent swing high or supply zone above
setups.sl_placement: Below the price low by 10-15 pips
setups.risk_factor: CCI is laggy in ranging markets; validate with MA slope

setups.name: Williams %R Divergence (Price HH, %R LH in overbought)
setups.description: Price makes HH while Williams %R makes LH near overbought (-20); warns of reversal.
setups.entry_condition: Short entry after %R crosses below -20 + price rejection
setups.invalidation: Price closes above entry high + %R spikes above -20
setups.tp_logic: Target: swing low or demand zone below entry
setups.sl_placement: Above the price high + 10 pips
setups.risk_factor: Williams %R can be choppy in ranging markets; use with price action

setups.name: Williams %R Divergence (Price LL, %R HL in oversold)
setups.description: Price makes LL while Williams %R makes HL near oversold (-80); warns of reversal.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry after %R crosses above -80 + price rejection
setups.invalidation: Price closes below entry low + %R spikes below -80
setups.tp_logic: Target: swing high or supply zone above entry
setups.sl_placement: Below the price low - 10 pips
setups.risk_factor: Can be choppy in tight ranges; combine with ATR for volatility context

setups.name: CMF Divergence (Price Up, Money Flow Down)
setups.description: Price makes HH but CMF makes LH; indicates money is flowing out despite price advance.
setups.entry_condition: Short entry after CMF dips below its MA + price fails above resistance
setups.invalidation: CMF spikes back above zero + price breaks high
setups.tp_logic: Target: swing low below entry; scale profits at -R levels
setups.sl_placement: Above the price high
setups.risk_factor: CMF can stay positive in very strong trends; validate with volume bars

setups.name: A/D Divergence (Price New High, A/D Doesn't Confirm)
setups.description: Price makes new high (intraday) but A/D line fails to confirm new high; suggests institutional selling.
setups.entry_condition: Short entry after A/D line divergence + volume decline on push
setups.invalidation: A/D line breaks above its previous high + price holds above entry
setups.tp_logic: Target: previous swing low or support below entry
setups.sl_placement: Above the price new high
setups.risk_factor: A/D is cumulative; check for gaps affecting the line; validate with price

setups.name: Multi-Timeframe Divergence (M5 HHL, M15 LLH — Alignment Entry)
setups.description: M5 shows bullish divergence (HHL) while M15 confirms with LLH + price action alignment.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry when M5 divergence triggers + M15 in confluence (demand zone, above MA)
setups.invalidation: M15 divergence breaks (price closes below LL on M15)
setups.tp_logic: Scale: 1st target M15 swing high; 2nd: structural resistance above
setups.sl_placement: Below the M5 lower low
setups.risk_factor: Multi-TF setups are powerful but require both TFs to align; false if HTF reverses

setups.name: Divergence + Support/Resistance Confluence (Entry Zone Sharp)
setups.description: Divergence signal originates exactly at a confluent SR level; increases probability.
setups.entry_condition: Entry when divergence low/high touches the exact SR level + candle rejection
setups.invalidation: Price closes beyond the SR level (false breakout)
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: next resistance above; 2nd: structural high
setups.sl_placement: Below the divergence level by 1 ATR
setups.risk_factor: Confluence increases risk of
if price clips and reverses; use tight SL

setups.name: Divergence + Moving Average Confluence (Price Bounces Off MA)
setups.description: Divergence signal forms exactly where price touches a key MA (EMA21, EMA50, EMA200).
setups.entry_condition: Long entry when price bounces off EMA + divergence HL setup + candle close above MA
setups.invalidation: Price closes below the MA on a follow-up candle
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: previous swing high; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the MA by 10-15 pips
setups.risk_factor: MA can be penetrated in strong trends; validate HTF bias

setups.name: Divergence + Pattern Breakout (Hidden Pattern Divergence Flag)
setups.description: Divergence signal emerges as price breaks a flag pole; divergence predicts breakout direction.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry on flag breakout + divergence (RSI HHL) supporting upside
setups.invalidation: Price closes back inside the flag or below the breakout candle close
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: flag pole height projected above breakout; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the flag base
setups.risk_factor: Pattern breakouts often fail; use tight SL at flag base

setups.name: Reversal-Bar Divergence (Divergence Candle Pattern + Indicator)
setups.description: Price makes LL while indicator makes HL, AND price forms a strong reversal candle (hammer, pin bar, engulfing).
setups.entry_condition: Long entry on reversal candle close above its open + divergence confirmed
setups.invalidation: Price closes below the reversal candle low on next bar
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: swing high above entry; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the reversal candle low
setups.risk_factor: Reversal candles are subjective; ensure clear body/wick ratio

setups.name: Divergence + Volume Spike (Divergence Reversal + Climactic Volume)
setups.description: Divergence forms at a point where volume spikes above average; indicates institutional reversal.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry after volume spike + divergence (LL, RSI HL) + candle close above entry high
setups.invalidation: Volume normalizes + price closes back below divergence level
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: swing high; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the volume spike candle low
setups.risk_factor: Volume spikes can occur in both directions; validate with price action + divergence

setups.name: Divergence + Fibonacci Level (Retrace Level RSI Divergence)
setups.description: Divergence signal originates at a key Fib level (38.2%, 50%, 61.8%); multi-layer confluence.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry when price bounces at Fib level + RSI/MACD divergence (HL) + candle confirmation
setups.invalidation: Price closes below the Fib level on a follow-up candle
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: previous swing high; 2nd: next Fib extension level above
setups.sl_placement: Below the Fib retracement level
setups.risk_factor: Fib levels are probabilistic; divergence provides edge, but no guarantee

setups.name: Divergence Histogram Cross (MACD Bars Flip from Negative to Positive)
setups.description: MACD histogram bars transition from red (negative) to green (positive) while price makes LL; bullish momentum turn.
setups.entry_condition: Long entry when histogram flips + price closes above a key level + volume confirmation
setups.invalidation: Histogram flips back to red on next bar or price closes below entry
setups.tp_logic: 1st target: swing high above entry; 2nd: structural resistance
setups.sl_placement: Below the lower low or support zone
setups.risk_factor: Histogram flips can be false; wait for 2-3 bar confirmation

setups.name: Divergence False Signal Detector (Divergence but Trend Continues — Re-entry)
setups.description: Divergence signal appears (e.g., RSI HHL), but price breaks past the divergence high and trends; detects false signal for re-entry.
setups.entry_condition: Re-enter in trend direction when price breaks divergence level + closes above/below on high volume
setups.invalidation: Price reverses back into divergence zone on the same bar
setups.tp_logic: Scale into trend: 1st TP at swing high; 2nd: structural resistance; trail SL above MA
setups.sl_placement: Below the last divergence level (tight SL, then trail)
setups.timeframe_best: H1, M15 (re-entry on breakout of failed divergence)
confluence: Price breaks divergence level on high volume
setups.risk_factor: This is a trap detector + re-entry strategy; only if HTF strongly confirms trend
